categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies signing logic affecting PSBT RPCs (`descriptorprocesspsbt` and `utxoupdatepsbt`) with regression tests in `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where PSBT RPCs leaked unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into inputs and outputs. As described in issue #36323, combining descriptors into a single signing provider caused MuSig2 metadata to be unconditionally attached to unrelated inputs; deferring this until checking aggregate key involvement restores the correctness of returned PSBT data.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Affects PSBT signing logic and RPC tests without touching wallet code; category rules note descriptor or PSBT changes affecting only RPC without wallet code are rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: The change is confined to `src/script/sign.cpp` and `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py` for non-wallet PSBT RPC processing.
